running_thesis: Fed hikes and rising yields are the main backdrop: Polymarket has a 25 bps December hike at 87.5% and 50+ bps at 9.2%, with the 10-year at 5.15% and real yields rising. The Nasdaq-100 is the higher-beta index (VXN minus VIX 10.08) and fell 1.22% on 13 Nov vs 0.40% for the S&P 500. NVDA's CEO resigned (8-K), an overlay before earnings. Credit shows no stress (HY OAS 3.2). Next tests: Warsh speech Mon 18:00 Vienna, retail sales Tue, FOMC minutes Wed. Cboe posts supplied are old content.
open_questions: Does the NVDA CEO change alter the earnings reaction?
Will Warsh, retail sales and FOMC minutes harden the December hike path, including the 50+ bps odds?
Is the 5 Nov Nasdaq-100 drop of 6.36% fully digested?
Does the COR1M jump to 11.8 signal rising index-level correlation?

themes.Oil retreat: fading, official data stale to 11 Nov, headlines conflict
